_doc: How to find a pose for a scene (docs/design/pose-picking.md). poses: one entry per pose in data/poses.json (same names): desc = what the body does, as seen; ground = what touches the ground (feet, one-knee, seat, front, back, air, feet-hands); hold = hands (right, left) that can carry a prop as the pose stands; use = story moments (tags below); like = nearest other poses. tags: the story moments, each with the words that call for it in a scene line (word stems, matched at the start of a word). notWords: words that start like a tag word but aren't (Sita, ready â€¦). wanted: poses the scenes ask for that don't exist yet, in the order to make them; until = what to use meanwhile. bases: the distinct lower bodies (legs + lean + tail), one-word names set by the artist, each with desc and the poses that carry it (the first is drawn in the base catalogue); every pose belongs to exactly one base (a test checks). gestures: the distinct upper bodies (arms + chest/neck/head + mouth), same shape and rules (gesture catalogue; a prop and its angle keep gestures apart); a gesture whose meaning includes tipping the whole body (a bow) carries that as lean, degrees added to the base's lean when composing, with the feet kept by the leg solve. Angles stay in data/poses.json; this file is only for finding.

arch.desc: a slight arch back, knees bent

fallback.desc: tipped onto the back, legs kicked up

kneel.desc: one knee down, the other foot forward

leanback.desc: leaning far back from the hips, legs braced

leanfront.desc: leaning forward, front knee deep in a stride

lunge.desc: a very long stride, front knee bent deep

pass.desc: walking, one leg passing the other

runwide.desc: a running stride, the back shin swung high

sit.desc: on the ground, one knee up, one leg out

sitback.desc: seated leaning back on the hands, legs out

stepwide.desc: a wide stride, weight on the back leg

walk.desc: a walking step, back heel up

armfront.desc: right arm thrust straight ahead, left arm back

flank.desc: both hands at the hip, the blade sweeping down behind the leg

key.desc: both hands tight at the chest, the blade level ahead

longpoint.desc: both arms straight forward, the sword level at the opponent

middle.desc: both hands at the waist, the blade level ahead

onarms.desc: the chest raised on the forearms

onhands.desc: arms reaching to the ground, hands planted

ox.desc: both hands at the temple, the blade level at the opponent's face

palms.desc: both forearms up, palms together at the chest

plow.desc: both hands at the front hip, the blade angled up at the throat

point.desc: right arm straight out, pointing finger

pointup.desc: right arm straight up, pointing finger

propback.desc: leaning back on straight arms, the hands propped behind

pumplow.desc: fists swinging, head down in the stride

reach.desc: both arms reaching forward and down

roof.desc: both hands before the chin, the sword up and back over the shoulder

swordacross.desc: both hands up, the sword level across the top of the head

swordback.desc: right arm far back with the sword, left forward

swordbehind.desc: both hands over the head, the sword pointing back

swordcarry.desc: one hand the sword, swung far back; the other arm carrying a figure against the chest

sworddown.desc: both hands low and forward, the sword cutting down ahead

swordfront.desc: right arm straight ahead with the sword

swordhip.desc: both hands at the right hip, the sword down and forward

swordlevel.desc: both hands forward, the sword level at the opponent

swordlow.desc: right arm low, the sword down and forward

swordshoulder.desc: both hands at the right shoulder, the sword up over it

swordup.desc: both hands overhead, the sword straight up

swordwaist.desc: both hands at the waist, the sword angled up toward the opponent

unicorn.desc: both hands raised high, the blade pointing up and forward

wrath.desc: both hands at the shoulder, the sword swept back over it

stand.note: plain presence; turn the head with look, open the mouth with mouth

arch-overhead.desc: bent knees, both arms raised and bent back over the head, head tipped back

bend-reach.desc: deep bend from the hips, knees bent, both arms hanging forward toward the ground

chair-armrest.desc: seated on a throne or chair, knees apart, forearms on the armrests (artist's lab save "chair")

crawl-onhands.desc: body low and pitched forward, arms reaching ahead to the ground, legs in a long step

crouch-cross.desc: squatting low, both arms crossed over the head

fallback-flung.desc: falling onto the back: body tipped back, legs kicked up, arms flung out

fallfront-armsdown.desc: pitching forward head first, arms thrown toward the ground, legs trailing

kneel-bow.desc: kneeling with the body bowed forward, head low, palms joined in front of the chest

kneel-handslow.desc: one knee down, the other foot forward, body upright, arms bent low in front

kneel-palms.desc: kneeling on one knee, palms together in front of the chest

kneeup-armsup.desc: both arms up and out, one knee lifted

leanback-armsback.desc: leaning back from the hips, arms straight down and back

leanback-bowhigh.desc: leaning far back, the full draw aimed high - the long shot

leanback-roof.desc: leaning far back, both hands before the chin, the sword up and back over the shoulder - the cut wound up to its fullest (also a club)

leanback-unicorn.desc: leaning back, both hands raised high, the blade pointing up and forward (also a club)

leanback-wrath.desc: leaning back, both hands at the shoulder, the sword swept back over it (also a club)

leanfront-barrier.desc: leaning forward into a wide stance, both hands low and forward, the point at the ground ahead (also a club)

leanfront-fists.desc: wide crouched stance, both fists up in front

leanfront-hanging.desc: leaning forward into a wide stance, both hands high and forward, the blade hanging down at the opponent (also a club)

leap-reach.desc: mid-air jump forward: front knee high, back leg trailing, arms forward

leapup-reachup.desc: jumping up with both arms raised high, legs tucked

liefront-dive.desc: flying flat, head first, both arms stretched ahead, legs straight behind

liefront-onarms.desc: lying on the belly, head and chest raised on the arms

lunge-armfront.desc: very long stride, body driving forward, right arm thrust ahead, left arm back

lunge-longpoint.desc: deep lunge, both arms straight forward, the sword level at the opponent (also a club)

lunge-sworddown.desc: lunge, both hands on the hilt low and forward, sword cutting down ahead (also a club)

lunge-swordfront.desc: deep lunge, right arm straight forward with the sword pointing ahead, left arm back

lunge-swordlow.desc: lunge, right arm low and forward with the sword pointing down and forward, left arm back

pass-swing.desc: walking, the left leg passing the standing right leg, arms close to the body

run-pump.desc: running stride, body forward, fists swinging at the sides

runlow-pumplow.desc: crouched running stride, head down, fists

runwide-hang.desc: running stride with both arms swept back

sit-armknee.desc: sitting on the ground, right knee up, left leg out, right arm on the knee

sitback-propback.desc: sitting leaning back on both hands, legs out in front

stand-pointup.desc: standing, right arm straight up pointing at the sky

step-akimbo.desc: standing upright, both fists on the hips, chest out

step-bowdraw.desc: side-on stance, left arm straight forward holding the bow upright, right hand drawing the string back to the ear, elbow behind

step-bowhigh.desc: the full draw tipped back from the chest, bow aimed high for a long shot

step-bowloose.desc: standing, left arm forward with the bow tipped, right hand flung back open past the ear (arrow loosed)

step-crown.desc: small stance, both hands at the chest, the sword upright before the face (also a club)

step-fool.desc: small stance, both hands low in front, the blade sloping down ahead (also a club)

step-holdhead.desc: standing, right hand on top of the head, left arm down

step-key.desc: small stance, both hands tight at the chest, the blade level ahead (also a club)

step-palms.desc: standing, both forearms up, palms together in front of the chest

step-point.desc: standing, right arm straight out pointing forward, left fist down

step-roof.desc: small stance, both hands before the chin, the sword up and back over the shoulder (also a club)

step-swordacross.desc: stride, both hands above the head, sword level across the top as a guard (also a club)

step-swordbehind.desc: wide stance, front knee bent, both hands above the head, sword held level over it pointing back (high guard; also a club)

step-swordhip.desc: stride, both hands at the right hip, sword pointing down and forward (also a club)

step-swordlevel.desc: stride, both arms straight forward, sword level at the opponent (also a club)

step-swordshoulder.desc: standing in a stride, both hands at the right shoulder, sword pointing up and back over it (also a club)

step-swordup.desc: standing in a stride, both hands above the head holding the sword up (also a club)

step-swordwaist.desc: knees bent, both hands at the waist, sword angled up toward the opponent (also a club)

stepback-armback.desc: wide stance, right arm swung back behind, left arm out forward

stepback-armsout.desc: stepping back on the left foot, body tipped back, arms out

stepback-change.desc: weight back, both hands low, the sword trailing down and back beside the leg (also a club)

stepturn-armface.desc: stepping back, right arm raised across the face, left arm out

stepwide-flank.desc: wide stance, both hands at the hip, the blade sweeping down behind the leg (also a club)

stepwide-middle.desc: wide stance, both hands at the waist, the blade level ahead (also a club)

stepwide-ox.desc: wide stance, both hands at the temple, the blade level at the opponent's face (also a club)

stepwide-plow.desc: wide stance, both hands at the front hip, the blade angled up at the throat (also a club)

stepwide-swordback.desc: weight on the back leg, right arm swung far back with the sword, left arm forward

stepwide-swordcarry.desc: weight on the back leg, right arm swung far back with the sword, the left arm carrying a figure (Ravana with Sita)

walk-swing.desc: walking step: right leg forward, left leg back on its toes, arms swinging opposite to the legs

stand-carry-overhead.desc: standing, both arms straight up holding something above the head

stand-pull.desc: leaning back, both arms forward gripping, as in pulling a rope or a person
stand-pull.until: stand-lean-back with both arms adjusted forward

sit-cross-legged.desc: seated upright, legs folded (throne, reading, teaching)

walk-carry-shoulder.desc: walking with a load on the right shoulder, right hand up holding it
walk-carry-shoulder.until: stand with the right arm adjusted

stand-embrace.desc: both arms forward and bent at chest height, to fold around another figure
stand-embrace.until: stand with both arms forward (shoulder ~70, elbow ~70)

lie-back.desc: lying flat on the back, arms at the sides or one across the chest (sleep, death)

sit-ride.desc: seated astride or on a chariot, legs down, arms forward holding reins or a bow
sit-ride.until: the Pushpaka: stand or sit on the chariot prop (on: chariot)

stand-carry-arm.desc: upright, one arm clamped round a figure carried against the chest, legs together (lifted into the air it is Ravana flying off with Sita)
stand-carry-arm.until: step-hang lifted into the sky, the legs closed and the toes pointed (right/left.leg.hip 12/-2, knee 8/0, ankle -45) and the far arm across her (shoulder 70, elbow 40); she arch-overhead in view front about 1.8 head-units ahead at chest height, listed before him so his arm crosses in front of her (06.02-06.06)

crouch-ready.desc: deep crouch, knees bent, body gathered, arms back, about to leap
crouch-ready.until: bend-low (reads as searching the ground, not gathering: 08.05)

sit-hand-on-head.desc: sitting, one hand on the head (despair, heavy thought)
sit-hand-on-head.until: sit with the right arm adjusted (shoulder ~170, elbow ~140)

stand-clasp-hands.desc: two figures standing, right hands clasped (alliance, friendship)
stand-clasp-hands.until: stand with the right arm forward (07.05)

stand-arms-out.desc: standing, both arms thrown out, palms open (wailing, a complaint, grief)

sit-slump.desc: sitting on the ground, knees up, shoulders fallen, head low (hopeless)
sit-slump.until: sit with spine.chest 30-35, which reads as collapsing (08.04; problem-poses)

sit-carried.desc: carried on a shoulder or back: seated high, legs hanging, one hand holding on
sit-carried.until: sit with lift over the carrier, placed so the carrier's head stays visible (07.04)

walk-hand-on-head.desc: walking with one hand pressed to the head (searching in grief)
walk-hand-on-head.until: walk with the right arm adjusted (06.10)
